['Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value', 'From activities', 'Inner Join assays On activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id', 'Inner Join target_dictionary On assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid', 'Inner Join molecule_structures On activities.molregno = molecule_structures.molregno', 'Inner Join molecule_dictionary On molecule_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno', 'Inner Join compound_records On assays.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id', 'Inner Join docs On compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id', 'Inner Join target_dictionary As t_d On assays.tid = t_d.tid', 'Filter target_dictionary.tid = 1855', "Filter assays.assay_type = 'B'", "Filter activities.standard_relation = '='", 'Filter activities.standard_value Is Not Null', 'Filter activities.pchembl_value Is Not Null', "Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'", 'Filter target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606', 'Order By molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id', 'Limit 1000', 'Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value']
